profile.name: Frédéric Crousaz
profile.headline: Event Officer / Coordinateur d'événements & opérations
profile.summary: Professionnel de la gestion opérationnelle d'événements avec cinq années d'expérience dans l'organisation de grandes conférences internationales, la mise en place des inscriptions et la conclusion de contrats fournisseurs jusqu'à la livraison sur site. Disponible pour les déplacements sur site.

jobs.title: After-Sales Service Group Leader – Geneva
jobs.description: For over 100 years, our family business has been developing customised solutions in the construction and installation of lifts. With 120 employees, Ascenseurs Menétrey SA continues to combine tradition, innovation and proximity. In view of an upcoming retirement, we are looking for our future:   After-Sales Service Group Leader – Geneva Based at our Geneva office, you are a true link between the field teams and our clients and hold a central position within our after-sales service activity. Available and attentive, you set the course for your team and support them daily in their tasks, with a constant focus on quality and customer satisfaction. If uniting a team around a goal, tackling operational challenges and actively contributing to the success of our company motivates you, then this position is made for you.   As a group leader, you are responsible for the following tasks: Supervise and support a team of 10 after-sales service and special works technicians (repairs) Ensure the administrative and human follow-up of your team (hours, holidays, annual meetings, etc.) Manage your group’s activity: Monitor and analyse performance and quality indicators (failure rate, visit rate, recurring faults, etc.) to guide the team towards achieving its objectives Maintain close collaboration with our technical sales staff: Preparing quotes, managing priorities, client communication, etc. Provide your technical expertise and support technicians in complex situations Promote a safety culture within your team by actively contributing to its dissemination, raising awareness among your team and applying good QSE practices Actively contribute to the development of work processes and your team’s skills Occasionally prepare offers in support of the technicians Your background and talents: You hold a qualification in a technical field (mechanics, electricity, automation, etc.) and have several years of proven experience in the lift sector With strong leadership skills, you are recognised for your ability to unite and develop a team, combining high standards, relational courage, listening and kindness Proactive, you show initiative and are solution-oriented Autonomous and organised by nature, you manage your priorities effectively Thanks to your calm and pragmatic character, you know how to adapt to unforeseen events Your place of residence allows you to reach Geneva within 45 minutes at most You hold a valid driving licence We offer you: A stable and rewarding position within a human-sized family business A working environment based on trust and collaboration, where mutual support among colleagues is a daily reality A fulfilling corporate environment where your ideas are heard and where you can actively contribute to improvement projects Flexible working conditions, with genuine attention to work-life balance, including bridging days offered on public holidays

jobs.title: External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region
jobs.description: Pacovis is a solid Swiss company, owner-managed, that has believed in the future for 90 years. As a reliable service provider for production and supply processes in the catering and food sector, we are enthusiastic about finding solutions for our clients. A contagious enthusiasm. Perhaps you too? As part of a planned long-term succession, we are seeking your support. As a   External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region You strengthen our sales team, enrich our company with joy, drive and competence, and live your personal and professional happiness. In this role, you are responsible for the sales area assigned to you and manage it independently. We are explicitly not looking for a classic "representative." You engage with your clients as an equal and are a competent contact, a problem solver and a source of ideas for our clients. This is a role in which you will thrive and for which we grant you the necessary time. Your responsibilities You accompany and advise our clients comprehensively, in the spirit of a committed service provider You prospect with passion, perseverance and negotiation talent You are able to correctly identify clients’ needs, potentials and opportunities and proactively contribute to the development of marketable solutions You tenaciously achieve the jointly defined objectivesYou carry out projects independently, reliably and within deadlines You love our clients and our products Your profile Perseverance, mental flexibility, social skills and a sense of responsibility are among your strengths. You have a complete professional training and several years of professional experience in a managerial position with great personal responsibility as a business leader (or similar) in the gastronomy, catering or food sector. If you are not unfamiliar with the sales sector, you are welcome as a candidate. We will help you change career paths. Your centre of life is located in the Geneva region. Your prospects The challenge ahead is to grow and gain skills through daily tasks in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with the "gastronomy & catering" sales manager as well as with the internal service. We offer you a job with great personal responsibility, good social benefits and the possibility to arrange your working hours flexibly; a company car completes our benefits package. Contact: Are you enthusiastic? If you see this mission as an opportunity and a challenge to take on, then convince us by sending your complete application file with photo, exclusively via Application Form , Human Resources, Pacovis AG, Grabenmattenstrasse 19, 5608 Stetten. Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications sent by e-mail or post, nor those from recruitment agencies.

jobs.description: dnata Switzerland AG est un acteur de référence issu du groupe de renommée mondiale : Emirates. Nous assurons des services au sol dans l’aviation commerciale en Suisse et sommes basés dans les aéroports de Genève et de Zürich. Nous comptons environ 1'100 employés et assurons 35'000 vols par an pour plus de 60 compagnies aériennes du monde entier. Nous accueillons nos précieux passagers dans nos salons Marhaba. Nous recherchons pour notre service Passagers, secteur Ticketing & Disruption à l’aéroport de Genève , un.e Agent d'Escale Ticketing & Disruption entre 80% et 100% (H/F) Date d’entrée en fonction : 04.01.2027   Les perspectives qui t’attendent Tu aimes le contact avec des passagers du monde entier et travailler en équipe ? Nous voulons te faire vivre une expérience professionnelle passionnante, au cœur d’un domaine ouvert sur l’international. Une formation complète dès ton entrée en fonction et tout au long de ta carrière s’offre à toi dans un cadre de travail convivial où chaque jour est différent.   Tes missions Accueil des passagers ; Renseignements aux passagers ; Vente et changement de billets ; Encaissement des excédents bagages ; « Re-routing » des passagers en cas d’annulation ou de retard ; Vente de divers services (visas, prestations VIP…).   Ton profil Expérience professionnelle dans un domaine en contact avec la clientèle ; Expérience en billetterie requise dans une agence de voyages, aéroport etc (une formation Iata sans expérience professionnelle n’est pas suffisante) ; Français langue maternelle ou excellente maîtrise ; Anglais courant ; Maîtrise des outils informatiques (un bon niveau d’Amadeus est exigé) ; Flexibilité ; Esprit d’équipe ; Ponctualité ; Bonne présentation ; Esprit d’initiative ; Bonne résistance au stress ; Sens de la communication ; Casier judiciaire vierge.   Horaires irréguliers tous les jours, y compris les week-ends.   Tu souhaites faire décoller ta carrière ? Tu veux progresser dans un environnement dynamique et passionnant où l’esprit d’équipe est important ? Rejoins-nous !

jobs.title: Live Marketing Manager, Trade Fairs & Events 80 - 100 %
jobs.description: You build the stage on which our brand becomes tangible. Trade fairs and events in Switzerland and internationally, right in the heart of the motorcycle and mountain bike scene: You ensure that the iXS brand convinces in live marketing. ABOUT iXS We commit to protect. You commit to ride. Since 1979, we have been developing highly functional protective clothing for motorcycles and mountain bikes in Sursee and are represented worldwide. We have been awarded multiple times with the Design & Innovation Award and are closely connected with athletes and key opinion leaders from the motorcycle and mountain bike world globally. iXS is part of the hostettler group. THIS IS WHAT IT'S ABOUT At trade fairs and events, dealers, distributors, media, as well as end consumers, experience our brand up close. A strong presence is created together: marketing managers develop goals, messages, and content. Sales, product management, graphics, partners, and service providers contribute their expertise. You turn this into a presentation that works and hold the reins from the initial planning to the debriefing. Additionally, you support the marketing team with logistics and administration, from samples for our sponsored athletes to the invoice from the stand builder. WHAT TO EXPECT An evolving event mix: We continuously review which trade fairs and events are worthwhile and test new formats. Your experience and ideas flow directly into this Two worlds, two target groups: You move within the motorcycle and mountain bike scenes and implement each appearance so that it resonates within its scene A job with seasonal dynamics: During intense phases, you are on the road, including weekends. Quieter times are used for planning and further development Collaboration as a success factor: You report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with internal departments, team members, partners, and our distributors at home and abroad, because we believe success is created together Your Tasks You plan, organise, and implement trade fairs, dealer and brand events, as well as scene events in Switzerland and internationally, independently from registration to dismantling, and are present at the most important occasions You manage external partners, agencies, and service providers You implement product and brand presentations together with internal departments You support the sales team at sales meetings and in the showrooms You measure the success of each event and improve our appearances from time to time You organise the shipping of product samples to athletes and media as well as logistics for shoots at home and abroad You procure displays, POS materials, giveaways, and merchandise, manage stock and inventory, and keep budgets, offers, and invoices under control Your Profile At least 3 years of experience with trade fairs and events, ideally international and in the two-wheeler, sports, or outdoor industry, as well as training or further education in event or marketing You keep an overview of several projects simultaneously and are familiar with budgets, service providers, and logistics abroad including customs You have an eye for spatial presentation and appear confident towards internal and external partners as well as within your team Collaboration is important to you: You involve other departments, partners, and service providers early and pull together with them You are hands-on, help with setup and dismantling, and remain calm when things get hectic You communicate confidently in German and English and are proficient with Microsoft 365 and project management tools. French and Italian are a plus You enjoy working in the office as well as on the road, including weekends during the season You hold a category B driving licence We are especially pleased if you yourself ride a motorcycle or mountain bike and know the scene from the inside. What We Offer A versatile key role at a Swiss brand with a history since 1979 Trade fairs and events in Switzerland and internationally, close to the motorcycle and mountain bike scene A dedicated marketing team with flat hierarchies An innovative company in a future-oriented market environment and a tangible team spirit Attractive workplace in Sursee with free parking facilities Promotion of personal development including support for internal and external training Above-average paid absence days as well as 16 weeks maternity and 3 weeks paternity leave Flexible working hours model, 5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from age 50 and/or in a managerial role) and continuously paid public holidays Possibility of home office and holiday purchase as well as flexible part-time positions Attractive employee discounts on all products of the hostettler group Various discounts with partners (insurance, fleet discounts, courses, tickets, etc.) Diverse events and activities, such as our legendary hoschi-days Are you interested? Then we look forward to your online application! #hostettlerjobs   We do without a classic cover letter. Instead, please answer the following question: Tell us about a trade fair or event where something went differently at short notice than planned. What did you do, who did you involve, and what do you do differently since then?   Applications from recruitment agencies will not be considered.

jobs.description: Connecting people - experiencing innovations! Kilchenmann is the strongest provider in Switzerland of services for professional audio, video and communication technology as well as multimedia complete solutions. The headquarters are in Kehrsatz-Bern, with further branches in Neuenhof, Pratteln, St. Gallen and Lausanne as well as in Eschbach (D). Our portfolio includes comprehensive audio-video solutions, digital signage, LED video walls, customer flow management, video conferencing systems, event and rental services, and much more. For our Meeting & Event Services division, we are looking for an experienced leader as Lead Event Management (a) 80-100% , who develops people, reliably manages operational services and, together with their team, ensures an excellent customer experience.   Your role As Lead Event Management, you lead and develop a team of up to eight employees. You manage the day-to-day operations and ensure a professional, reliable service at a high quality level. In doing so, you combine high customer expectations with efficient processes, conscious use of resources and economic thinking.   Unlike in classic hospitality or catering, we do not focus on daily guest operations. We support meetings, conferences and corporate events in an international corporate environment. Clear standards and recurring formats form the basis. At the same time, flexibility and creative solutions are required for individual requirements. Our claim: excellent service that combines quality and economy.   Your tasks Leading and developing a team of up to eight employees in event management and event coordination (including scheduling of technical/operational staff) Ensuring professional customer care and reliable execution of events, meetings and conferences (Monday to Friday) Central contact person for our contract partner and maintaining a partnership-based, solution-oriented collaboration Managing daily business and coordinating requirements, priorities and resources Close coordination with the specialist lead for scheduling, representing them if necessary and setting clear priorities in case of bottlenecks or short-term changes Collecting customer feedback and concerns and finding suitable solutions within the agreed service and cost framework Joint improvement with those responsible for our processes, standards and services Close cooperation with internal departments and external partners   Your profile Several years of leadership experience and enjoyment in promoting employees and further developing a team Experience in the event, meeting, conference or hospitality sector or in a similar service environment Experience in planning and coordinating events as well as in deployment and resource planning A good sense for customers and their needs as well as solution finding The ability to keep an overview and set priorities even in hectic situations A solution-oriented approach, decisiveness and clear communication Entrepreneurial thinking and a good understanding of quality, resources and costs Enjoyment in continuously improving processes and services Very good Microsoft 365 skills as well as confident German and English language skills   We offer you Active participation: The opportunity to contribute your ideas – with us, commitment is truly appreciated! Team spirit: We live an open, friendly and communal corporate culture – whether in daily work, at an aperitif or one of our regular staff events Equality: Collaboration on equal footing, where everyone is valued from day one Development: We support our employees not only "on the job" but also encourage external training – the opportunity to develop into a construction site technician is a matter of course for us Work-life balance: Flexible working models such as changes in workload, unpaid leave to optimally balance work and private life External employee counselling: Support in all life situations through professional advice from our partner Attractive benefits: Tickets for sporting or cultural events or Brands for Employees (new offers every week) Health management: Discounts on fitness subscriptions or bike to work, which really pay off for your well-being   One more thing… You or you (formal)? For us, no question. Whether apprentices, technicians, service managers or management, we all use the informal "you". This is part of our uncomplicated and authentic company culture on equal terms. Because we want you to get to know us as we are, right from the first contact.   Is this something for you? Don’t hesitate and contact us today!   Lorenz Gitzi looks forward to receiving your written and complete application documents via the application button.
